name: aisms
description: AI-Based Student Management System (AISMS) - Full Stack Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && echo 'Setup complete. Run: npm run dev'
